findings.namedBuyers: Two relevant organizer-side relationship candidates: Ellen Aiello, Senior Manager, Event Services, MaRS Discovery District; and Louise Pichette, Director, Health Sciences, MaRS Discovery District. Ellen’s role supports an operational referral, and she publicly promoted the April 23, 2026 edition. Louise is quoted in MaRS’s 2025 and 2026 announcements discussing the summit and is a relevant programme-side sponsor/referral. Neither source establishes hotel purchasing authority, a housing remit, or 2027 contract control. Use impactweek@marsdd.com to request routing; no personal email or phone is asserted.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced: May 12–13, 2027, MaRS Centre, 101 College Street, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. These are event activity dates, not publication dates, and are within the requested horizon. The homepage states “May 12 and 13, 2027, you’re invited to MaRS Impact Health.” The program page says the 2027 program will be announced soon. The FAQ still describes April 23, 2026: treat it as prior-edition content, not a competing 2027 date. No 2028 edition was established in the reviewed sources.
findings.hotelProductFit: Commercial inference using the supplied hotel specifications: conditional lodging-only fit, not a whole-conference venue or exclusive housing fit. The 2027 homepage advertises 1,000+ attendees and 100+ speakers; neither is a room requirement or an audited 2027 attendance count. A 157-room hotel and approximately 240-theatre largest room cannot host that full programme. Credible targets are a limited speaker/VIP/investor or out-of-town delegate allocation, with small side meetings only if requested. A proposed 15–40-room pilot would be a sales test, not forecast demand. MaRS Centre is at College Street rather than the hotel’s Harbourfront location, so MTCC walkability is not an event-specific advantage; validate transfers before positioning convenience. City-conference lodging fits better than a resort/retreat proposition. Do not promise catering or receptions before verifying current hotel food-and-beverage operations.
findings.venueCommitments: The 2027 event is publicly located at MaRS Centre, 101 College St., Toronto, ON. This is downtown Toronto proper, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. The contact address specifies MaRS Centre, South Tower, 101 College Street, Suite 100. That is an organizer contact address, not proof of the precise conference rooms. Published venue selection is confirmed; a signed venue contract, room allocation and hotel commitment are not public. MaRS Centre is not a competing hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified edition timeline: May 3–4, 2023; June 12–13, 2024; May 7–8, 2025; April 23, 2026; and announced May 12–13, 2027. All identify MaRS Centre in downtown Toronto. The reviewed history shows repeat use of the organizer’s home venue, not destination or hotel rotation. MaRS explicitly calls the summit annual in its 2025 announcement, but the month and duration vary; no 2028 dates should be extrapolated.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown / hotel sourcing unconfirmed. No edition-specific housing bureau, host hotel, hotel room block, lodging partner or open accommodation RFP was found in the reviewed public event, registration, FAQ, partner and contact pages. Hotels listed as committed: none found; this is not evidence that no private arrangements exist. The homepage publishes only “Location: MaRS Centre, 101 College St., Toronto, ON.” The FAQ states “For sponsorship or community partnership inquiries, please contact impactweek@marsdd.com”; this is an inquiry route, not an invitation to tender or proof that lodging is open. Attendee self-booking is also unverified.
findings.organizationStructure: MaRS Discovery District owns/presents its flagship MaRS Impact Health summit. MaRS describes itself as a charitable organization and urban innovation hub supporting Canadian technology companies, not a membership association, PCO or DMC. The selected meeting venue is its MaRS Centre. No external PCO, DMC, housing bureau or hotel buyer was identified in the reviewed sources; do not conflate the event owner, venue team, programme leadership and lodging purchaser.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The main conference is already assigned to MaRS Centre: do not pursue relocation of the 2027 core programme. No named incumbent hotel, exclusive lodging agreement, documented hotel sell-out, compression, overflow requirement or unmet room demand was found. A small hotel allocation remains a hypothesis; absence of a public hotel list is not evidence of open inventory. The Harbourfront-to-College Street location difference is a positioning limitation, not a quantified distance or proven attendee objection.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send one targeted inquiry to impactweek@marsdd.com referencing May 12–13, 2027 and requesting referral to Ellen Aiello and the person responsible for speaker/delegate lodging. Ask whether accommodation is centrally purchased or self-booked; whether hotels/bureau, exclusivity or existing allocations apply; booking/decision dates; non-local speaker and delegate counts; arrival/departure pattern; peak rooms and room nights; and whether a non-exclusive Harbourfront lodging option with a booking link is useful. Offer a provisional, non-binding 15–40-room pilot only after buyer interest and hotel availability are confirmed; it is not a demand estimate. Use Louise Pichette as a programme-side relationship referral, not an assumed contracting buyer. If 2027 is committed, request the next review window. Verify transfer logistics and hotel food-and-beverage status before proposing side events.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The upcoming 2027 edition has verified dates and venue, but hotel-sales accessibility is unconfirmed. The public general/partnership route is impactweek@marsdd.com; no accommodation tender or bookable event hotel block was found. Classify as venue confirmed with lodging qualification required, not committed elsewhere and not hotel sourcing open. Public programme and speaker pages state 2027 details are forthcoming; the FAQ remains on 2026.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: repeat MaRS Centre use and explicitly annual positioning support ongoing organizer relationship development for preferred lodging, speaker accommodation or small delegate allocations. This is lodging capture, not rotation-driven venue capture. Qualify 2027 first; if privately committed, seek the next lodging review/renewal window without assuming a 2028 edition, dates, room demand or access. No sourced overflow or current preferred-hotel agreement establishes an immediately displaceable competitor.
